settings.content: This theme is the MemoBrick storefront. Content is edited in the creator files.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Displayed in browser tabs and search results. Square image, at least 32 x 32px, works best.

settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: Used when a page is shared on social media and that page has no image of its own (for example, the homepage). Recommended size: 1200 x 630px.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold ($)
settings.info: Shown in the cart drawer's free-shipping progress bar.

settings.content: Create the form in the Hulk Form Builder app, turn on its app embed under Theme settings → App embeds, then paste the Form ID below.

settings.label: Free Proof request — Hulk Form ID
settings.info: Used on the Free Proof page (/pages/free-preview) and the homepage's 'Let us design it' view.

settings.content: Saves a picture of every design customers make (including ones who never order) to your Google Drive, so you can see what people designed and where they gave up.

settings.label: Google Apps Script web app URL
settings.info: Paste the /exec URL from the Apps Script deployment.

settings.label: Secret key
settings.info: Must match SECRET_KEY in the Apps Script. Any random word works.

settings.label: Also save the customer's original photo

settings.content: 1st ask: right after the customer uploads their photo. 2nd ask (only if they tapped Skip): a small card that never blocks the editor, shown once they've kept designing for a while and paused — or, on desktop, when they move to leave the page. Emails are saved as Shopify customers (tagged), which Omnisend syncs. Never shown to logged-in customers.

settings.label: Ask for email in the design tool
Wait after upload
settings.info: 0 = ask immediately after the photo is uploaded.

settings.label: Heading
settings.default: Great photo! Let’s save your design 🎨

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Enter your email before you start, so your design is saved and you can come back and finish it anytime.

settings.label: Small print
settings.default: We'll also send design tips and offers. Unsubscribe anytime.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Add your email so your design is kept safe. You can keep designing.

settings.label: Desktop 'leaving' text
settings.default: Enter your email and your mosaic will be waiting for you when you come back.

settings.label: Customer tags
settings.info: Comma separated. Use the 'started-design' tag to trigger your Omnisend reminder automation.

settings.content: When a customer adds a design to the cart, sends Omnisend a custom event with a picture of THEIR design. Build an Omnisend workflow triggered by this event to email them their own mosaic. Needs the Omnisend app embed turned on.

settings.label: Custom event name
settings.info: Must match the trigger name in your Omnisend workflow.
